{{Quote|The bounty on Louis, as well as his brothers, was placed by a man named Lucien. He leads the Bofa Treat Gang who use this bunker here as their hideout.|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
The '''Bofa Treat Gang''' was a criminal group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Their leader was [[Lucien Bender]].

==Organization==
{{Quote|Not bad. Not bad at all. You handle yourself well. The Bofa Treat Gang never stood a chance.|Bossk, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
[[File:Bofa_Treat_Gang_Member.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Bofa Treat Gang thug, wearing the gang's typical style of clothing.]]
The Bofa Treat Gang was active on the planet Corellia. It was based in a [[Bofa Treat Gang bunker|bunker]] near the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]]. Members of the gang usually wore blue shirts, gray undershirts and blue/gray pants.<ref name="SWG:B" />

==History==
{{Quote|What Lucien apparently does not realize is that there is a much larger bounty on him. I would prefer that larger bounty. You take care of Lucien and his gang, and I'll let Louis go.|Bossk, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
The Bofa Treat Gang was created by the cyborg and mad scientist Lucien Bender after his three sons &mdash; [[Hraykken Bender|Hraykken]], [[Draykken Bender|Draykken]] and [[Louis Bender]] &mdash; escaped their abusive father with the help of a [[Meatlump King|man]] who would later become the [[Meatlump King]]. The man and the three Bender brothers founded the [[Meatlumps]],<ref name="SWG:B" /> a gang of technology-hating fanatics named after their favorite food.<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meet the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref> In response, Lucien Bender created the Bofa Treat Gang,<ref name="SWG:B" /> named after [[bofa treat]]s: sweet, dried, fruit based snackfood.<ref name="SWG:BT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Item Decription: "Bofa Treat"</ref>

[[File:Lucien_Bender.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Lucien Bender]], the leader of the Bofa Treat Gang.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the vindictive Lucien Bender placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his three traitorous sons. However, he ignored that a much larger bounty was placed on him and his gang.<ref name="SWG:B" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] was considering to capture the three sons when he discovered that there was a much more lucrative bounty on Lucien's head. He therefore decided to use the three brothers to collect it. Shortly after he had captured the first brother, Louis Bender, near Kor Vella, a spacer affiliated with the Meatlump gang arrived at Bossk's little camp near the Bofa Treat Gang's hideout. Bossk forced the Meatlump to take down the Bofa Treat Gang and their leader for him in exchange of Louis Bender. The spacer entered the hideout and fought his way through the bunker until he finally met Lucien. The ensuing firefight resulted in Lucien's death.<ref name="SWG:B" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bofa Treat Gang appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:B" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Bofa Treat Gang was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," released on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref>
